page.overview:
Who is Maenadrin?

Maenadrin is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

Maenadrin and Negaine were surprised to see Egwene al'Vere in the Brown Ajah quarters very late at night. In reality, Egwene had been following her usual path to the novice quarters and was just as surprised to see the Brown sisters on reaching what she thought was her destination. This confusion was a result in a shift in the Pattern which had swapped the locations of part of the novice quarters with a portion of those belonging to the Brown Ajah.

The swap occured without any of those inside the affected areas feeling any motion or vibration. Maenadrin, along with the other Browns in the same situation, continued to live in her old room in the middle of the novice quarters as the alternative would have been to be squeezed into a much smaller and basic accommodation provided to a novice.
